thread:
tariq: Quick sync: working on the Optimize toolkit docs update. Found a couple of mismatches across batching/caching/quant pages after runtime v1.4.0. Will open a coordination PR that bundles snippet fixes + a short migration note.

anna: Nice. Which mismatches specifically?

marco: The big ones I saw: quant profiles still list `q4_kv` and `q3_fast` in different places; runtime now has `q4_fast_kv` and `q3_balanced`. Also a few SDK snippets reference `kv_prefetch()` (deprecated) vs new `prefetch_kv()`; examples in JS + Rust need tiny edits.

jin: I can handle JS snippets. I ran the sample-runner locally and one streaming test flips out when the sample uses `batch_size: 0` as a sentinel. We should avoid that in examples.

tariq: Good catch. For batching examples let's show a tiny-batch pattern explicitly: `batch_size: 4` + mention "use auto-batching for >64 concurrent short requests". Keep examples minimal.

anna: For the quant table I propose a one-line migration block under each profile: e.g., `Note: q4_kv has been replaced by q4_fast_kv (v1.4.0). If you relied on q4_kv for KV-heavy workloads, test q4_fast_kv and q3_balanced for mixed workloads.` Short and actionable.

marco: Also add a crossref from /docs/optimize/heuristics.md to the quant profiles page so readers get perf/cost tradeoffs. I can add the link.

jin: On the SDK rename: change `client.kv_prefetch(keys)` to `client.prefetch_kv(keys)` (same call semantics). For Rust streaming samples remember to use `tokio::time::sleep(..).await` not `std::thread::sleep(..)` in async tests.

tariq: Can we standardize the snippet pattern across languages: 1) prefetch keys; 2) await prefetch; 3) generate with `max_tokens` small for sample, 4) stream consumer. That will make automated smoke tests easier.

docs-bot: Reminder: add `@docs-bot sample-run` to PR body to trigger sample-runner once ready. Also run `yarn docs-lint` and `cargo test --doc` before pushing.

anna: I'll update quant table and add the one-liner migration note. Will push a commit to the draft branch.

marco: I'll add the crossref and fix the JS snippets (replace batch sentinel and prefetch rename).

jin: I'll update the Rust snippets and add a tiny CI test that runs only the prefetch streaming sample.

tariq: Plan: anna updates quant profiles + migration note; marco updates JS + crossref; jin updates Rust + test; I'll squash into a single PR that touches /docs/optimize/* and include changelog entry `/docs/release-notes/1.4.0.md` with migration bullets. Tagging @marco @jin @anna for reviews.

marco: I'll review samples fast, ping when ready.

jin: Pushing Rust fixes in ~20m. Tests locally pass.

anna: pushed quant table update. small wording change: used "KV-optimized" in the table header for clarity.

tariq: Thanks. Once everything's in, add `@docs-bot sample-run` and I'll queue the PR. Aim to merge by EOD if CI is green.

docs-bot: Automated note: to get faster feedback, you can add `docs/optimize/quant-profiles` to the PR labels to trigger the heuristic test suite.

marco: Added the label. Looks good from my side.

tariq: Great work everyone. Short, practical migration notes only. :rocket:
